thread:
sam: Quick sync from the on-call pairing. We should finalise semantics for 'snapshot_age' and make clear it's eventually-consistent. Ops saw runaway loops when snapshots were polled at 5ms intervals.

maria: Let's document recommended poll rates (>=100ms) and circuit-breaker behaviour: if snapshot_age < 50ms, return an error to caller to avoid tight-loop abuse.

ashwin: Also propose an exponential backoff suggestion encoded in `CreditsReply.wait_ms_suggestion` for clients to follow when deferred. Don't make it enforced server-side.

devon: Thought: include a `snapshot_diagnostics` payload with (last_applied_seq, estimated_staleness_ms) for debug-only traces. Keep it disabled by default to avoid payload bloat.

tiffany: On warmup limits: add tenant-configurable params: `warmup_tokens_per_minute` and `small_warmup_threshold`. Ops can tune per-cluster.

infra-bot: canary deploy note: branch `admission-lifelines` rolled to 10% of runtime pods; observed 0.3% increase in grant_latency_ms.

sam: Small increase expected. Monitor warmup_accept_rate to ensure we don't let caches thrash.

maria: Final ask: make Dedicated translator emit a metric `translator_request_mismatch` when legacy lease params don't map cleanly; will help sales/offboarding.

ashwin: I'll add TTL mapping heuristics doc: lease_ttl -> soft_deadline_ms = max(lease_ttl*1000/2, 2000) to avoid very short deadlines.

devon: I'll push the proto and a unit-test matrix for the mapping heuristics.

tiffany: Running warmup experiment now, will post numbers. If bypass fixes p99 we should consider default enabling for Hosted only.

sam: Cool. Please link the follow-up RFC once PR is open.
